title: Chapter 2 · The Weeping Catacombs

panels.panel_text: A cold draft carries names spoken centuries ago. Stone sarcophagi line the corridor, their seals cracked by frost.
A soft silvery light breaks through a fractured ceiling dome, illuminating dancing motes of stardust.
An automated automaton forged of darksteel and Netherese runes bars the iron gate, demanding a password of pure magic.
Beyond the catacomb wall lies a sprawling vista of the Barovian mists churning under a blood-red moon.

choices: 1. Lawful Good — Offer a prayer to Selûne and disarm the trap protecting the vault.
2. Neutral Good — Guide the lost spirit safely through the iron gate.
3. Chaotic Good — Overload the arcane ward to shatter the automated guardian.
4. Utility — Analyze the Netherese inscriptions for hidden magical conduits.
5. Action — Charge past the guardian into the weeping catacombs.

title: Chapter 3 · The Obsidian Observatory

panels.panel_text: Glass spires rise toward a blackened dome where celestial charts shift in real-time.
A spectral projection of the Weave flickers across the brass instruments, signaling an imminent collapse.
Ancient tombs float weightlessly in the center of the chamber, bound by magnetic arcane chains.
The multiversal gears lock into place. Every choice made across Barovia converges upon this single focal point.

choices: 1. Lawful Good — Secure the floating codex to stabilize the regional ley lines.
2. Neutral Good — Calibrate the astral lens to protect civilian outposts below.
3. Chaotic Good — Sever the magnetic chains and let the knowledge scatter freely.
4. Utility — Record the celestial convergence vectors into your personal journal.
5. Action — Seize the core mechanism before the observatory collapses.
